profile.headline: Software Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services
profile.summary:
Graduated with a Master’s degree in Information Technology and Analytics from Rutgers University in 2020, building a strong foundation in data science and proactive design thinking. Academic achievements include recognition as a top-performing graduate student.  

Currently contributing as a Software Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services, leveraging expertise in design thinking, Java, and IT-driven solutions. Dedicated to driving innovation and delivering impactful outcomes in the technology domain.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Participated and provided data insights in department meetings to design a solution using data analytics to recognize and automatically notify spam calls, benefiting 150+ million customers across the United States 
• Implemented 5G APIs to develop an application for first-responders, resulting in quicker emergency response which is currently being processed for a patent 
• Delivered the advantages of 5G APIs for first-responders to the executive team and led the discussion to implement this prototype

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed & developed an android application to implement a learning management system that is being used by 97 universities 
• Utilized an educational dashboard to publish results and insights between students, faculties and university administration  
• Decreased data-fetch time by 15% for university android application by establishing FTP connection

honors.title: Top performing graduate student

projects.title: H-1B Visa Predictor
projects.description:
Analyzed H-1B dataset with around 2.5 million data-points and used Python libraries to plot data insights 

Implemented data pre-processing and feature engineering techniques to discover relevant features from a set of 35 features 

Developed Machine Learning models using PySpark on AWS MapReduce and discovered Neural Network has the highest accuracy of 93%

projects.title: Spotify Music Playlist
projects.description:
Predicted popularity of a song based on its audio features using various supervised machine learning methods in Python

Developed a personalized music recommender system using unsupervised machine learning in Python, with 74% accuracy
